SCOPE AND DEVICE: The card's helper is RosDriver and the card's expected mode is simulated; this package uses that helper and mode with no deviation. The selected device is the shipped Easys camera pipeline: the Gazebo camera bridged as ROS 2 sensor_msgs/msg/Image on /camera and the concrete balloon_detect node's annotated Image output on image_processed. Both streams are captured through cap.sensing.image.v1's selector profile as complete bounded local PNG artifacts (not metadata): the test cases read the artifact bytes and the exact ROS 2 header. Source citations are bridge_topic.yaml:38-42, easys_a1.sdf:268-283, balloon_detect.py:12-17, 20-55, 85-89 and 91-108, and joy_sim.launch.xml:5-10. The detector publisher name is relative; the declared /image_processed assumes the root namespace used by the launch, and remapping is a deployment choice outside the upstream facts.

NOT COVERED / WHY: The sim-env's primary vehicle control surface is the four thruster command publications (/left_down/cmd_thruster etc., bridge_topic.yaml:2-24), plus /imu and /tf (bridge_topic.yaml:26-36), Gazebo physics and world step, pause and reset. The pinned clone declares no acknowledged ROS stop, pause, reset or world-control service; a zero-thrust topic publication is not an acknowledged stop (MHS/sdk/docs/ros-driver.md), and the Gazebo world-control service is not bridged by bridge_topic.yaml. This package therefore does not expose or claim the mobile-base control, does not substitute observation for it, and serves only the passive camera device. The card's role is sim-env; the selected camera pipeline is one shipped component of that environment.

FAKE AND FIDELITY: fake.py is a ROS-free RecordingRosTransport contract stand-in, not a replay of captured traffic and not the upstream simulator. It answers the two Image subscriptions with canned 2x2 rgb8 frames; the real sensor is 320x240 at 30 Hz and the fake does not run Gazebo, ros_gz_bridge, balloon_detect, OpenCV masks or bounding boxes. F0, analytic engine, determinism none, timestep_ms 0, realtime_factor 0, reset none, no snapshot/restore. All fake numbers, pixels, frame ids and stamps are placeholders. The production RosDriver/RosBridge/ros_images path performs the image conversion; the adapter is exercised through the stock server. No numeric Limit is declared because the only input is the closed camera selector; site-limits.example.json is not needed.

BACKEND AND DEPLOYMENT: the package declares only the fake backend .fake:FakeEasysSim; the production RosBridge/ros_images code path performs the conversion, not fake.py. A live run needs the operator's rosbridge endpoint, Gazebo Garden, ros_gz_bridge and a running balloon_detect node, and was not constructed or tested here. RosDriver additionally refuses every hardware backend without a human hardware review, and reviewed_by remains null.
